paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Data Analyst position at Northwind Analytics. With a Master's in Computer Application and hands-on experience turning raw data into decisions stakeholders act on, I would be glad to bring that same discipline to your team.

As a Business Analyst Intern, I streamlined data collection and reporting procedures, cutting processing time by 20%, and built 15+ reports and presentations that drove actionable outcomes. My project work includes machine learning models reaching 96% forecasting accuracy and 87% fraud-detection accuracy, grounded in careful data cleaning and validation.

What draws me to Northwind is your reputation for rigorous, ethical data practice. I work the same way: every metric I cite traces back to a verified source, and every model I ship includes the caveats it deserves. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your analytics roadmap.
Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.
